court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: State, Rep by the Inspector of Police and Another
case_number: Crl.O.P. No. 31227 of 2022 and Crl.MP. No. 19081 of 2022
advocates: For R 1: Mr. A. Gopinath, Government Advocate (Crl. Side)
prayer: Prayer: Criminal Original petition filed under Section 482 of CrPC to call for the records in CC.1741/2022 pending on the file of the Additional Mahila Court (Magistrate Level) at Coimbatore and Quash the same against the petitioners.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

G.K. Ilanthiraiyan, J.:— This criminal original petition has been filed to quash the proceedings in CC.1741/2022 pending on the file of the Additional Mahila Court (Magistrate Level) at Coimbatore.

2. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this petition and he has also made an endorsement to that effect.

3. In view of the endorsement made by the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, this criminal original petition is dismissed as withdrawn. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
